subject: Request: TAM roster, on-call coverage, and incident comms playbook
messages:
From: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@firsthorizon.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: Alyssa Cole <procurement@firsthorizon.com>, Brian O'Neil <brian.oneil@firsthorizon.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Oct 2028 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: RFP: Support & TAM questionnaire — follow-up

Evelyn —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our RFP evaluation we have a short section focused on post-sale support and customer success. Attached is the specific questionnaire (FH_RFP_Support_Questions.pdf). Our security and ops teams want clarity on the following so we can feed answers into our procurement matrix: 

1) Dedicated TAM coverage model — roster, escalation tiers, SLA response times.
2) On-call hours and overlap across US/EU regions; what counts as "business hours" vs "24/7 critical".
3) Incident communications: typical cadence, channels (email/pager/phone), and examples of post-incident reports.
4) Runbooks and playbooks availability — can you share a sample incident playbook?

Can you return a single consolidated response and a roster spreadsheet with primary/secondary contacts by role? We are working toward final vendor recommendation by 2028-10-20.

Clara Nguyen
Sr. Procurement Manager
First Horizon Bank

[Attachment: FH_RFP_Support_Questions.pdf (document)]

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@firsthorizon.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Alyssa Cole <procurement@firsthorizon.com>, Brian O'Neil <brian.oneil@firsthorizon.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Oct 2028 14:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Support & TAM questionnaire — follow-up

Clara —

Appreciate the clear list — we've gone through the attached questionnaire and prepared consolidated materials. In short: yes, we provide named TAMs with escalation tiers, 24/7 critical incident response, and standardized post-incident reporting. Details attached: Redwood_TAM_Roster.xlsx and Incident_Comms_Playbook_v1.2.pdf. Highlights below for the procurement matrix: 

• TAM coverage model: Assigned Primary TAM + Secondary TAM per account. Primary is the day-to-day technical account lead; Secondary covers overlap and escalation. For large enterprise accounts we provide a Technical Account Lead (TAL) + Solutions Architect as part of onboarding.
• Escalation tiers: TAM -> Support Engineering -> Escalation Lead -> Duty Incident Commander -> Executive On-Call. Expected acknowledgement SLAs: Critical: 15 minutes, High: 1 hour, Medium: 4 hours. Resolution SLAs are workload-dependent; we provide target SLAs in the roster for typical incident classes.
• Hours: Business hours defined per region (US: M-F 9am–6pm ET, EU: M-F 9am–6pm CET). Critical incidents are covered 24/7 by our on-call rotations. Non-critical requests outside business hours are triaged on next business day unless classified as High/Critical.
• Incident comms cadence: initial acknowledgement, hourly updates for Critical until mitigation, then a rapid post-incident summary within 24 hours and a full RCA within 5 business days for Priority incidents. Channels: Pager (PagerDuty), secure email thread, and optional phone bridge.
• Runbooks: We maintain playbooks for network, model-serving, and degradation scenarios. The attached playbook is a sanitized sample suitable for procurement review.

We're happy to schedule a 30-minute call with security/ops to walk the playbook. If you need any redlines or additional evidence (SOC2 artifact pointers, KMS diagrams), include a list and we'll pull them into the same packet.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

[Attachments: Redwood_TAM_Roster.xlsx (spreadsheet); Incident_Comms_Playbook_v1.2.pdf (document)]

From: Brian O'Neil <brian.oneil@firsthorizon.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 10:11:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Support & TAM questionnaire — follow-up

Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying questions from our Security team after reviewing the playbook: 

1) In the playbook you reference a "Duty Incident Commander" role — can you confirm whether that person is internal to Redwood or can be a named customer contact for joint incident command?
2) We need audit-friendly delivery for post-incident reports — what is the retention period for RCAs and will they be exported into our archive if requested?
3) For the PagerDuty integration, does Redwood support per-tenant escalation policies and service keys?

If you can respond briefly to these items and then we can set the call.

-Brian
Principal Security Engineer
First Horizon Bank

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Questions from First Horizon (pager, retention, incident commander)

Evelyn / Marissa / Vivek —

Looping you in to draft a tight reply to Brian's three items. Suggested short answers below — please edit before I send: 

1) Duty Incident Commander: internal to Redwood by default. We support a joint incident command model for enterprise accounts (customer can nominate a lead). Recommend we offer joint incident command for FH given regulatory posture; list in roster as "Joint option available".
2) RCA retention: We retain post-incident reports and RCAs in our incident archive for a minimum of 7 years for enterprise customers with the compliance add-on. Standard retention is 2 years. We can provide export as PDF/structured JSON on request; note additional fees apply for extended archival exports.
3) PagerDuty: Yes, we support per-tenant escalation policies and per-account service keys; can integrate into FH's existing routing. We will provide an integration checklist.

Action: Evelyn, can you confirm the wording on retention and joint incident command? Vivek, please attach the integration checklist and confirm any operational caveats. Marissa, confirm who will be named as primary TAM in the roster (I propose Amanda Li as primary, backup David Kim).

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@firsthorizon.com>, Brian O'Neil <brian.oneil@firsthorizon.com>, Alyssa Cole <procurement@firsthorizon.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Penelope Diaz <penelope@cyberassurance.io>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 15:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Support & TAM questionnaire — follow-up

Brian / Clara / Alyssa —

Thanks for the follow-up questions. Below are concise answers and we've attached the integration checklist and a revised roster that lists primary/secondary TAMs and the proposed joint incident command option. 

1) Duty Incident Commander: Redwood operates with internal Incident Commanders by default. For regulated customers we offer a Joint Incident Command option where the customer's incident lead joins the command bridge as co-commander. We'll add this as an option in the contract and document the responsibilities in the SOC/ops appendix.

2) RCA retention: Base retention for incident summaries and RCAs is 2 years. With the Compliance Add-on (enterprise tier) retention extends to 7 years. We can deliver RCAs as PDF and as sanitized structured JSON for archiving. We'll include an export clause in the SOW (export timeline and fees).

3) PagerDuty integration: We support per-tenant escalation policies and per-account service keys. Our integration checklist (attached) includes recommended escalation policy templates and test steps.

Next steps: 
• I've attached: Redwood_TAM_Roster.xlsx (named contacts + role + timezone), Incident_Comms_Playbook_v1.2.pdf (sanitized), and PagerDuty_Integration_Checklist.pdf.
• If acceptable, Ben and I can schedule a 30-minute technical review with your security/ops team next week (I proposed 2028-10-17 11:00am ET).

Please let us know any additional artifacts (SOC2 report pointers, key management diagrams) and Penelope from CyberAssurance is CC'd in case you want an independent validation contact.

Best —
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

[Attachments: Redwood_TAM_Roster.xlsx (spreadsheet); Incident_Comms_Playbook_v1.2.pdf (document); PagerDuty_Integration_Checklist.pdf (document)]
